ordered_diagnoses: Embolic Phenomenon due to Cardiac Tumor
Renal Infarction due to Tumor Embolism

facts.raw_span: 1 day of acute left flank pain
cyclical fevers
No specific physical examination findings
Elevated lactate dehydrogenase
Immunostains revealed a malignant spindle cell tumor
Cytogenetics by fluorescence in situ hybridization showed SS18 (SYT;18q11.2) translocation
Immunohistochemistry positive for epithelial membrane antigen (EMA)
Initial computed tomography (CT) showed renal infarction
Trans-thoracic echocardiography (TTE) showed a large left ventricular (LV) mass
Trans-esophageal echocardiography (TEE) noted a pedunculated LV mass emanating from the basal septum protruding into the LV cavity
Cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (cMRI) confirmed the mass location
Endomyocardial biopsies revealed a malignant spindle cell tumor, histology consistent with the monophasic variant
